title: Garden sign
brief: Redesign of the /world front-garden sign. Each artboard shows (a) the sign in the garden with availability (Open to work / Busy), the owner's role and its rotating messages, by day and night, and (b) the click close-up: the sign on the left and a side card in the accepted case-story card family with profile, availability, core stack and contact actions. Content comes only from the site copy; missing items (email, home city) are marked to fill. Toggles: availability, day/night, pause, next; URL hash presets such as #night,busy.

artboards.title: Wooden board, upgraded
artboards.tradeoff: Belongs to the cottage garden and reads as hand-made (painted plank, lantern green when open, amber when busy, flip-tile line); the face holds only one rotating line besides status and role, so stack and links wait for the click.

artboards.title: Neon sign with LED ticker
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest night presence, readable from across the island, and the ticker carries every message in one 25 s loop; by day the tubes wash out, a moving line is harder to read, and it needs emissive glow/bloom in the 3D scene.

artboards.title: Standing e-ink kiosk
artboards.tradeoff: Most legible by day and night, and it shares the card's type, pill and labels, so sign and card read as one UI; it is the least garden-like object (a screen on a post in a cottage garden).
